title: Tidikelt language - Wikipedia
text: Tidikelt (also known as Tidikelt Tamazight, Tamazight or Tidikelt Berber) is a Zenati Berber language spoken in Algeria. It is one of the Mzab–Wargla languages.

title: Tamazight, Tidikelt Language (TIA)... | Ethnologue Free
text: Tidikelt Tamazight is an endangered indigenous language of Algeria. It belongs to the Afro-Asiatic language family. The language is used as a first language by older adults only. It is not known to be taught in schools.
